title: Backfill canonical clip and window embeddings for the real local library
description: Purpose: regenerate stale v1 embeddings from actual audio for canonical current library clips and four-bar windows, not relabel old vectors. Ground-only pinned CLAP/reproducible preprocessing; never cloud inference. Implement safe CLI consuming canonical export {samples,clips,recordings,analyses}, resolving sample files/aliases within declared repo root and verifying audio SHA. Read clip IDs directly, include current clips not only old manifest annotations, exclude retired/invalid and reconcile removed windows. Atomic v2 sidecar writes, bounded batch inference with per-region failures, resumable unchanged-input reuse, coverage report. Excludes tracked manifest edits, source audio edits, models/thresholdchanges, broad deletes, commits/push/close by Terra. Deterministic synthetic fixtures + real selected recording backfill supervisor-run; loading/progress reports current sample, interrupted run keeps completed sidecars, no fake vectors. Handoff RED/GREEN/fileinventory and remaining exclusions. Registration/runtime final integration by supervisor.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Terra file ownership: analysis/apricity_analyze/semantic_backfill.py, analysis/tests/test_semantic_backfill.py, scripts/semantic-backfill.py only. Consume catalogdict directly, share pinned clap sidecar API, bounded4 batch with single-region fallback on error, verify source audio SHA actual bytes before cache reuse. Explicit --catalog --samples --report [--sample-id repeat] [--batch-size <=8]. Output next to source manifest only; refuse roots/path escapes/symlink escapes and missing manifests. Never mutate canonical catalog/tracked manifests/audio. Supervisor generates export from migrated real library, runs first selected sample then full corpus. Validate canonical clipIDs/startend, currentanalyses manifest sourceSHA, gridfingerprint; atomics preserve oldsidecar when no valid current source; reports include reused/recomputed/excluded per-kind. Fixture tests first and no real model inference in ordinary tests. No board/git/close by Terra.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Supervisor review requires corrections before real data writes: reject duplicate/invalid canonical IDs and boolean batch-size; refuse source manifest symlinks outside declared root; catch per-sample hash/read failures with structured exclusions so other sources continue. CLI currently returns0 for source-fatal exclusions (wrongSHA/unsafepath/decode/writefailure); return nonzero for these while retirement/partial valid per-region coverage remains explicit. Do not claim persisted coverage if atomic sidecar write fails. Add deterministic regression tests before corrections. Never edit source audio/manifests and keep completed sidecars resumable.
